title: Replace milestone checkbox progress with manual slider control

requirements.text: Remove all checkbox-based progress tracking functionality from MilestoneSection and TaskCard components

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: No checkboxes are displayed for milestone or task completion
TaskCard components no longer include completion toggle controls
MilestoneSection header click behavior is disabled

requirements.text: Add a manual slider control to each milestone card that allows direct adjustment of progress percentage from 0% to 100%

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: Each milestone displays a horizontal slider input
Slider range is 0-100 representing percentage completion
Current progress percentage value is displayed next to the slider
Slider is fully interactive and responsive to user input

requirements.text: Add a progress field to the backend Milestone data model to store manually set progress percentage values (0-100)

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: Backend Milestone type includes a progress field of type Nat (0-100)
Default progress value is 0 for new milestones
Progress value persists across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Implement backend method updateMilestoneProgress that accepts milestone ID and progress percentage, updates the stored value, and returns success/failure

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: Method signature: updateMilestoneProgress(milestoneId: Text, progress: Nat) -> async Bool
Progress value is validated to be between 0-100
Method returns true on successful update, false otherwise
Method persists changes to stable storage

requirements.text: Create React Query mutation hook in useTasks that calls the backend updateMilestoneProgress method when slider value changes

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: Hook provides updateMilestoneProgress mutation function
Mutation successfully calls backend actor method
Mutation invalidates progress-related queries on success
Optimistic updates show immediate slider movement

requirements.text: Update progressUtils.ts to calculate phase and overall progress based on manually set milestone progress percentages instead of task completion counts

quotes: mejor has que la barra de progreso tengo un slider que se pueda actualizar

acceptanceCriteria: Phase progress is calculated as average of milestone progress values within that phase
Overall progress is calculated as average of all milestone progress values
Progress bars and percentages update immediately when slider values change
Calculations ignore task completion status entirely

requirements.text: Remove all completeTask mutation calls, task completion state management, and checkbox-related event handlers from the frontend codebase
acceptanceCriteria: useTasks hook no longer includes completeTask mutation
TaskCard component has no completion toggle logic
No click handlers remain for task or milestone completion
All checkbox-related console logging is removed

constraints: Do not change the backend single-actor architecture
Preserve the six-phase and 18-milestone structure defined in milestones.ts
Maintain Spanish language labels throughout the UI
Keep the warm earth-tones color scheme (no blue/purple)
Preserve task notes functionality and display
nonGoals: Automatic progress calculation based on task completion
